name: Io Moth
desc: Io Moth (Automeris io): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Automeris io, the Io moth (EYE-oh) or peacock moth, is a colorful North American moth in the family Saturniidae. The Io moth is also a member of the subfamily Hemileucinae.
